goal: Let members manage their own profile and let admins manage the member directory, with RLS enforcing the role boundary.

tasks.title: Auth with member-default sign-up and an admin bootstrap step
tasks.acceptanceCheck: A new sign-up defaults to the member role; running the bootstrap step promotes the first signed-up user to admin.

tasks.title: Own-profile edit, admin member directory and detail, role change, RLS
tasks.acceptanceCheck: A member edits their own display name and bio and cannot reach /members; an admin lists members, opens a member's detail, and changes their role; a member's direct database read of another profile is rejected by RLS.
